title: Normalized project areas (municipality + barangay)
summary: Library projects define affected areas as rows in project_affected_barangays; profiles store custom_municipality_id + custom_barangay (see migration_050 / municipalities table). GET /api/projects/{id}/municipalities returns {id,name} rows; GET /api/projects/{id}/barangays accepts municipality_id or legacy municipality filter; flat /barangays without query remains for older clients.
